Who We Are
About the College
Chhaygaon College has, for decades, stood as a center of learning for the
        youth of the region — nurturing knowledge, discipline, and a spirit of
        service. Our mission is to provide accessible, quality higher education
        while fostering critical thinking, cultural values, and civic responsibility
        among our students.
With dedicated faculty, a growing range of academic programmes, and an
        active campus life, the college continues to prepare students not just for
        careers, but for meaningful lives — rooted in their community and open to
        the wider world.

A Message from the Principal
Dear Students,
Welcome to our college! It is my pleasure to extend a warm greeting to each one of you on this momentous day of your admission. As the principal of this esteemed institution, I am filled with pride and excitement as I witness the beginning of your academic journey here.
Dr. Naba Kumar Kalita
